credits.title: Bonkey: The Mutated
credits.overview: An alien disease spreads like wildfire infecting a chain of unsuspecting victims. A man and his dog are all that stand in the way of containing the danger.

credits.title: Lost Tape
credits.overview: A videotape capturing the final moments of an amateur urban exploration group, who break into the long abandoned home of an unsolved murder.

credits.title: Capital
credits.overview: Floyd decides to visit the man who murdered his daughter a week before he's sent to the chair.
